label: copy phase: input 2 while outputting n (recalling the bigram "2 n"), mid-sequence
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input token is 2 (86% of mass) or n (14%). It is strongest when the input is a copied 2 and the token being output is n, meaning the original sequence had the bigram "2 n". Top activations all have 2 n at original positions 2-3 (e.g. m f 2 n c -> fires on the copied 2). Magnitude is highest when the n is recalled at recall_idx 3-4; it is weak or absent when the bigram is at original position 1 (recall_idx 2) and weaker again at later positions. Weaker secondary firing: on the copied n right after 2 n when the next output is also n (2 n n), on n->n repeats, and on 2 followed by other tokens (u, o, w). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any other input token. Predicate F1 on dev is about 0.62 (precision 0.74, mass recall 0.71). Adding n inputs or a wider position range trades precision for recall.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: n, 2, u, c, w, l; least: e, b, d, t) and the current input token, by step (t=8: 2, n; t=9: 2, n; t=10: 2, n); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=4 & t=6, recall_idx=4.
